scope: Deepen the existing TABLECONTENT route review for linked cell data, ATTDEF cell attributes, object ownership, and loss-reporting completeness across DWG and DXF paths.

sources.kind: authoritative format specification, ODA v5.4.1 section 20.4.97
observed: A TABLECONTENT cell has a linked-data flag; if set, it contains a hard pointer to a DATALINK object, a row count, a column count, and an unknown BL96 value before the cell-content count.
Cell-content items can contain ATTDEF handle, attribute text, and index tuples.
R24 DWG embeds TABLECONTENT in the TABLE entity, while DXF keeps TABLECONTENT as a separate object including R24; earlier DWG uses a separate TABLECONTENT object.
doesNotEstablish: Every extension-dictionary/NOD owner edge for a producer-authored linked table.
Spreadsheet refresh behavior or native CAD UI acceptance.
The exact byte profile of any drawing not inspected.

sources.kind: official Autodesk ACAD_TABLE entity DXF reference
sources.observed: The documented ACAD_TABLE entity includes TABLESTYLE, owner BLOCK_RECORD, FIELD, block-cell and attribute references, but is not the complete schema for a separate TABLECONTENT object.
doesNotEstablish: Absence of a DataLink reference in the separate TABLECONTENT object.
TABLECONTENT object ownership or DATALINK graph membership.

sources.kind: official Autodesk DXF group-code type reference
sources.observed: Groups 340-349 are hard-pointer handles, consistent with ODA's H340 DataLink field.
doesNotEstablish: Which TABLECONTENT object record owns or roots a given DATALINK.
Whether the format mapping preserves linked spreadsheet semantics.

sources.kind: peer implementation source snapshot, inspected locally only
observed: DWG read code stores the linked-data handle in a generic template ValueHandle and reads the three linked metadata values.
The inspected template Build body performs no DataLink assignment; the public TableEntity.Cell model exposes HasLinkedData but not the link identity or row/column metadata.
The inspected DWG writer emits a null handle and zero metadata when HasLinkedData is true, then throws.
doesNotEstablish: Behavior of every ACadSharp release or branch.
Producer-format truth or independent semantic correctness.

sources.observed: The schema and public structs expose cell has_linked_data/data_link/num_rows/num_cols/unknown fields and a distinct DATALINK object model with an owner handle.
doesNotEstablish: Complete stable writer/read support for the route.

sources.kind: maintainer statement about a DXF peer route
sources.observed: The maintainer characterizes ACAD_TABLE as preserved raw tags rather than a generally editable/queryable typed entity; a small text extraction helper does not provide full graph semantics.
doesNotEstablish: DATALINK preservation through all ezdxf operations.

sources.kind: peer project documentation for cross-document copy route
sources.observed: ACAD_TABLE is listed as unsupported by the xref route, and unsupported entities may be ignored without raising.
doesNotEstablish: Exact preservation of linked data under other operations.

filesReviewed: src/drw_entities.cpp: parseTableCell and DRW_Table::parseDwg semantic-completeness assignment
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h and dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp: absent DataLink retention override
observed: The parser consumes but does not retain the cell DataLink handle and three BL metadata fields.
The parser consumes but does not retain ATTDEF handle, attribute text, and index tuples in the existing cell attribute vector.
The parsed TABLECONTENT can be marked semantically complete after these losses.
The generic DataLink callback is no-op by default and dx_iface does not retain the object, so the converter has no closed cell-to-DATALINK output graph.
